content: Ta gizay yeletida nay laatay izas gidikkoka izi biidi laattana gakkanaas ayllefe dumma gidenna.
Iza aaway gida wodey gakkanaas izi bana dichchizayta, tamarsizayta kushen gam7ees.
Nuka kase Ayana yo7os guutha naa mala diza wode hayssa ha alameza woga garsan haaretti de7idos.
Gido attin kase ba qoppi woththida wodey gakkin Xoossay macasappe yeletidi woga naagida ba naaza nuus yeddides.
Hessika nuni iza nayta gidana malanne woga garsan dizayta wozzana mala hanides.
Inte iza nayta gidida gish Xoossa “Abbo” giidi xeygiza ba naaza Ayana nu woznan yeddides.
Hessa gish hayssafe guye ne naappe attin aylle gidakka. Neni naa gidida gish Xoossi nena bayssa laattizade histides.
Galatiya asas Phawuloosa qofa
Inte Xoosse eranappe kase Xoosse gidonta eeqatas aylleta.

Ha7i gidikko Xoosse erideta; qasseka Xoossan erettideta. Histin qasseka guye simmidi gede go7ay baynda coo daaburissiza timirtekko waanidi simmidetii? Simmidi qasseka aylletetha qambaran waaxettana koyetii?
Dumma gallassata, aginata, wodetanne laythata inte boncheta.
Ta intenara daaburidayssi coo mela gidande gaada babbays.
Ta ishato! Ta intena misatida mala inteka tana misatana mala ta intena woossays. Inte tana aykkokka qohibeykketa.
Inte eriza mala ta intes koyro Mishiraachcho qaala sabakiday sako gaasonna.
Ta sakoy intes meto gidinka tana saletibeyketa woykko tana harasettibeyketa; gido attin inte tana Xoossa kiitancha malanne hessafeka bollara Yesus Kirstoosa mala mokki ekideta.
Histin ha7i he inte ufayssay awa bidee? Intes hanizaz gididakko inte inte ayfe taas kessi immanas guye goontayssa ta intes markatays.
Tani tuma intes kessa yootida gish intes morke gidadinashaa?
Heyti asati intena bakko ekkanas daaburettes attin lo7os daaburettenna. Isti koyizay intena nuuppe shaakkidi ba as histanasakko!
Lo7os mindatethi lo7o; hessikka hananas bessizay ubba wode gidikkofe attin ta intenara diza wode xalla gidoppo.
Ta nayto Kirstoosi inte woznan xaafetin ta beyana gakkanaas inte gish ta miixatays.
Ta inte gish qofan metotadis. Ta dandayizakko ha7i inte giddon bettada intena lo7etha tamarsizako ay mala dosazina!
Agaaronne Saara leemiseteth
Inteno! Woga garsan aqana koyizayto ane taas yootite; wogay ay gizakkone siybeykketii?
Abrahaames issoy ayllefe issoy qas goqayfe yeletida nam7u nayti dizayssi Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Ayillefe yeletida naazi asho woga mala yelettides. Hanko goqaype yelettidayssi ufayssa qaala mala yelettides.
Hayti nam7u macasati nam7u caaqota bessizayta gidida gish hayssi leemisos imettides. Koyro caaqoya siina zuma bolla gidashe aylletethas gidiza nayta yelizaro; izakka Aggaro.
Hessa gish Aggara Arabe biittan diza siina zuma gish gidada ha7i diza Yerusalame katamayo misatawus; iza ba naytara aylletethan dawus.
Pude bolla salon diza Yerusalamey gidikko goqa gidada dawus; Izakka nu aayo.
“Neni yelonta makaraye ufayeta! Hanne miixata erontare! ‘Illili’ ga waassa; azinay dizaarippe azinay bayndari nayti darida” geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Hessa gish ta ishato! Inteka Yisaaqa mala ufaysa qaala naytakko.
Asho shene mala yeletidayssi Ayana wolqan yeletidayssa goodides; ha7ikka goodethon dees.
Gido attin Geeshsha Maxaafay qasse ay gizee? “Aylleyo izi naazara digga; aylle nay goqay naara lattenna” gees.
Hessa gish ta ishato! Nuni goqay nayta attin aylle nayta gidokko.
